title: Convergence Properties of PF-Exec: Homogeneous Structure, Anchored Closed Form, and Gain Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2611.17488v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper establishes a layered mathematical char acterisation of PF-Exec, the algorithm of the companion system paper. Demand-proportional bandwidth allocation yields an exact first-order homogeneous decomposition, from which the equal-load bandwidth target and its feasibility bound follow in closed form. The logarithmic knee view preserves strict load order and shares its global optimum with the Jain fairness index, while the demand-weighted centroid minimises the position potential. The damped softmax association block possesses a fixed point on the product of simplices. The truncated one-dimensional gain iteration admits a complete characterisation, with geomet ric convergence below the critical gain, initial-value-dependent bounded oscillation at it, and a family of bounded two-state cycles above it. translated_title: PF-Exec 的收敛性质：齐次结构、锚定闭式解与增益动力学
translated_abstract: 本文为 PF-Exec（配套系统论文中提出的算法）建立了分层式的数学刻画。需求成比例的带宽分配产生一个精确的一阶齐次分解，由此可以闭式形式导出等负载带宽目标及其可行性界。对数拐点视角保持了严格的负载顺序，并与 Jain 公平性指数共享同一个全局最优值，而需求加权的质心则使位置势能最小化。阻尼 softmax 关联模块在单纯形的乘积空间上存在一个不动点。截断的一维增益迭代获得了完整的刻画：低于临界增益时呈几何收敛，恰在临界增益处出现依赖初值的有界振荡，高于临界增益时则存在一族有界的双状态周期循环。全局不变误差球与显式跟踪递推共同完成了执行保证的表述。数值审计证实了上述结论。
tldr: 本文为 PF-Exec 算法提供了完整的分层数学刻画：由齐次分解闭式导出带宽目标与可行性界、证明对数拐点最优性与 Jain 公平指数一致、给出单纯形乘积上阻尼 softmax 的不动点存在性，并完整刻画了增益迭代在临界增益前几何收敛、临界处有界振荡、临界后出现有界双状态周期循环的行为。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes a layered mathematical characterisation of PF-Exec, deriving closed-form bandwidth targets and feasibility bounds via homogeneous decomposition, proving optimality equivalence with the Jain fairness index, establishing a damped softmax fixed point on the product of simplices, and fully characterising the truncated gain iteration—geometric convergence below the critical gain, bounded oscillation at it, and bounded two-state cycles above it.
